items.title: Recover corrupt ingestion checkpoints without losing output
items.summary: Verified corrupt-checkpoint recovery archives the bad checkpoint and replays input with tenant-plus-sequence deduplication while preserving output.
items.body: For corrupt-checkpoint recovery, move the corrupt checkpoint to `recovery/checkpoint.bad.json` beside the checkpoint. Preserve existing output, build a set of existing `(tenant, seq)` identities, and replay input while appending only unseen identities. Rewrite the checkpoint after replay. Filesystem assertions verified preservation of the corrupt checkpoint and all three events, including two tenants sharing sequence 1.
